description: This PHP source file defines the OrganizationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving and updating organization information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching existing organization data, validating input parameters for updates, and saving new organization details.

classes.name: OrganizationAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for managing organization information, including fetching current details and updating them.

methods.name: getOrganizationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the OrganizationService used for organization's business logic.

methods.name: setOrganizationService
methods.description: Sets the OrganizationService instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current organization information; returns default empty data if none exists.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Validates and saves updated organization information based on request parameters.

methods.name: saveOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Extracts organization data from request parameters, populates an Organization entity, and saves it via the OrganizationService.
